definition{
  name: natMember,
  parameters: [value : Nat, values : (List Nat)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match values
    | List.nil => false
    | List.cons head rest => ((value =? head) || (natMember value rest))),
  recursive_argument: values
}

definition{
  name: allMembers,
  parameters: [wanted : (List Nat), values : (List Nat)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match wanted
    | List.nil => true
    | List.cons head rest => ((natMember head values) && (allMembers rest values))),
  recursive_argument: wanted
}

definition{
  name: sameNats,
  parameters: [left : (List Nat), right : (List Nat)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match left
    | List.nil => (match right | List.nil => true | List.cons other more => false)
    | List.cons head rest => (match right
      | List.nil => false
      | List.cons other more => ((head =? other) && (sameNats rest more)))),
  recursive_argument: left
}

    | List.cons head rest => ((((project head index) =? wanted) && ((project head modelKindIndex) =? kind)) || (viewpointKindIs rest wanted kind))),

definition{
  name: viewpointsKnown,
  parameters: [records : (List Foundation.Arch::Viewpoint)],
  result: Bool,
  body: ((allMembers (viewpointStakeholders records) (stakeholderIndexes (stakeholderRecords))) && ((allMembers (viewpointConcerns records) (concernIndexes (concernRecords))) && (viewpointKindsBelow records)))
}

definition{
  name: viewsConform,
  parameters: [records : (List Foundation.Arch::View), framing : (List Foundation.Arch::Viewpoint)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match records
    | List.nil => true
    | List.cons head rest => ((viewpointKindIs framing (project head viewpointIndex) (project head modelKindIndex)) && (viewsConform rest framing))),
  recursive_argument: records
}

definition{
  name: edgeEndsIn,

  result: Bool,
  body: (match records
    | List.nil => false
    | List.cons head rest => ((((project head index) =? wanted) && ((natMember (project head fromIndex) ends) && (natMember (project head toIndex) ends))) || (edgeEndsIn rest wanted ends))),
  recursive_argument: records
}

definition{
  name: edgesWithin,
  parameters: [records : (List Foundation.Arch::Edge), wanted : (List Nat), ends : (List Nat)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match wanted
    | List.nil => true
    | List.cons head rest => ((edgeEndsIn records head ends) && (edgesWithin records rest ends))),
  recursive_argument: wanted
}

definition{

}

definition{
  name: specsKnown,
  parameters: [specs : (List ViewSpec)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match specs
    | List.nil => true
    | List.cons head rest => ((natMember (project head view) (viewIndexes (viewRecords))) && ((allMembers (project head components) (componentIndexes (componentRecords))) && ((edgesWithin (edgeRecords) (project head edges) (project head components)) && ((viewKindKnown (project head kind)) && (specsKnown rest)))))),
  recursive_argument: specs
}

definition{
  name: hasComponent,
  parameters: [wanted : String, records : (List Production.BrowserSystem::Component)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match records
    | List.nil => false
    | List.cons head rest => ((prim equal wanted (project head id) : Bool) || (hasComponent wanted rest))),
  recursive_argument: records
}

definition{
  name: hasArtifact,
  parameters: [wanted : String, records : (List Production.BrowserSystem::GeneratedArtifact)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match records
    | List.nil => false
    | List.cons head rest => ((prim equal wanted (project head id) : Bool) || (hasArtifact wanted rest))),
  recursive_argument: records
}

definition{
  name: hasTarget,
  parameters: [wanted : String, records : (List Production.BrowserSystem::Target)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match records
    | List.nil => false
    | List.cons head rest => ((prim equal wanted (project head id) : Bool) || (hasTarget wanted rest))),
  recursive_argument: records
}

definition{
  name: anchorResolves,
  parameters: [anchor : SystemRef, model : Production.BrowserSystem::SystemModel],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match anchor
    | SystemRef.Component key => (hasComponent key (project model components))
    | SystemRef.Artifact key => (hasArtifact key (project model artifacts))
    | SystemRef.Target key => (hasTarget key (project model targets))
    | SystemRef.External => true
    | SystemRef.Undeclared => true)
}

definition{
  name: anchorsResolve,
  parameters: [bindings : (List Binding), model : Production.BrowserSystem::SystemModel],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match bindings
    | List.nil => true
    | List.cons head rest => ((anchorResolves (project head anchor) model) && (anchorsResolve rest model))),
  recursive_argument: bindings
}

definition{
  name: undeclaredNames,
  parameters: [bindings : (List Binding)],
  result: (List String),
  body: (match bindings
    | List.nil => (nil String)
    | List.cons head rest => (match (project head anchor)
      | SystemRef.Undeclared => (cons (project head name) (undeclaredNames rest))
      | SystemRef.Component key => (undeclaredNames rest)
      | SystemRef.Artifact key => (undeclaredNames rest)
      | SystemRef.Target key => (undeclaredNames rest)
      | SystemRef.External => (undeclaredNames rest))),
  recursive_argument: bindings
}

definition{
  name: viewpointOfView,
  parameters: [records : (List Foundation.Arch::View), wanted : Nat],
  result: Nat,
  body: (match records
    | List.nil => 0
    | List.cons head rest => (if ((project head index) =? wanted) then (project head viewpointIndex) else (viewpointOfView rest wanted))),
  recursive_argument: records
}

definition{
  name: allAddress,
  parameters: [entries : (List Correspondence)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match entries
    | List.nil => true
    | List.cons head rest => ((viewpointFrames (viewpointRecords) (viewpointOfView (viewRecords) (project head view)) (project head concern)) && (allAddress rest))),
  recursive_argument: entries
}

definition{
  name: correspondenceConcerns,
  parameters: [entries : (List Correspondence)],
  result: (List Nat),
  body: (match entries
    | List.nil => (nil Nat)
    | List.cons head rest => (cons (project head concern) (correspondenceConcerns rest))),
  recursive_argument: entries
}

definition{
  name: firstTargetKind,
  parameters: [records : (List Production.BrowserSystem::Target)],
  result: String,
  body: (match records | List.nil => "" | List.cons head rest => (project head kind))
}

definition{
  name: systemBoundary,
  parameters: [model : Production.BrowserSystem::SystemModel],
  result: Bool,
  body: ((prim equal (project (project model applicationProfile) externalServices) "none" : Bool) && ((prim equal (project (project model applicationProfile) persistentStorage) "none" : Bool) && ((prim equal (project (project model applicationProfile) execution) "browser-session" : Bool) && (prim equal (firstTargetKind (project model targets)) "github-pages-browser" : Bool))))
}

definition{
  name: architectureValid,
  parameters: [],
  result: Bool,
  body: ((sameNats (narrativeIndexes (stakeholders)) (stakeholderIndexes (stakeholderRecords))) && ((sameNats (narrativeIndexes (concerns)) (concernIndexes (concernRecords))) && ((sameNats (narrativeIndexes (viewpoints)) (viewpointIndexes (viewpointRecords))) && ((sameNats (bindingIndexes (components)) (componentIndexes (componentRecords))) && ((allMembers (concernIndexes (concernRecords)) (viewpointConcerns (viewpointRecords))) && ((allMembers (stakeholderIndexes (stakeholderRecords)) (viewpointStakeholders (viewpointRecords))) && ((viewpointsKnown (viewpointRecords)) && ((viewsConform (viewRecords) (viewpointRecords)) && ((allMembers (viewpointIndexes (viewpointRecords)) (viewViewpoints (viewRecords))) && ((specsKnown (viewSpecs)) && ((anchorsResolve (components) (System::systemModel)) && ((allMembers (concernIndexes (concernRecords)) (correspondenceConcerns (correspondences))) && ((allAddress (correspondences)) && (systemBoundary (System::systemModel)))))))))))))))
}

theorem{
  name: architectureDescriptionHolds,
  parameters: [],
  statement: ((architectureValid) = true),
  proof: decide{}
}

theorem{
  name: undeclaredInSystem,
  parameters: [],
  statement: ((undeclaredNames (components)) = (cons "CLI adapter" (cons "Release binaries" (nil String)))),
  proof: decide{}
}
\end{semanticmodule}
\end{lexlean}
